target.title: fix(agent-core): skip handleRunFailure error forwarding for control-flow signals
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

When a tool result makes the next prompt exceed the context budget during a tool loop, `transformContext` throws `MidTurnPrecheckSignal` — a **control-flow mechanism** to trigger tool-result truncation and retry, not a terminal error.

However, `Agent.handleRunFailure` was treating this signal as a real error and pushing a synthetic failure event (`stopReason: "error"`) into the stream. Users see "Context overflow: prompt too large for the model (mid-turn precheck)." immediately, even though the retry succeeds ~15 seconds later via the `pendingMidTurnPrecheckRequest` side-channel callback.

Fixes [#101621](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101621).

## Why This Change Was Made

Mark `MidTurnPrecheckSignal` with a `Symbol.for("agent-core.controlFlowError")` sentinel so `Agent.handleRunFailure` can recognize control-flow signals and skip error-forwarding. The existing attempt-runner recovery path (`pendingMidTurnPrecheckRequest` callback) handles truncation and retry correctly. The symbol-based approach uses a generic, agent-core-owned name to keep the contract explicit without OpenClaw-specific coupling.

### Production call path (root cause)

```
transformContext() throws MidTurnPrecheckSignal
  → streamAssistantResponse() → runLoop() → runAgentLoop()
  → Agent.runPromptMessages()
  → Agent.runWithLifecycle() catch
    → handleRunFailure(error)  ← was pushing synthetic error to stream
```

`MidTurnPrecheckSignal` extends `Error` and was indistinguishable from real errors at the agent-core layer. The attempt-runner's `isMidTurnPrecheckSignal(err)` catch block was never reached because `handleRunFailure` swallowed the error first.

### Design decision

The `agent-loop.ts` EventStream API (`agentLoop`/`agentLoopContinue`) is **not used in production** — the production path goes through `Agent` → `runAgentLoop` (async). The sentinel check is scoped to `Agent.handleRunFailure` only; not applied to the public EventStream layer.

### Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `packages/agent-core/src/agent.ts` | Export `CONTROL_FLOW_ERROR` symbol; `handleRunFailure` returns early for sentinel errors |
| `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/midturn-precheck.ts` | Mark `MidTurnPrecheckSignal` with the sentinel in constructor |
| `packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts` | 2 new Agent-level tests |

### Files NOT changed

`agent-loop.ts`, `attempt.ts` recovery, `run.ts` retry, `tool-result-context-guard.ts`.

## User Impact

- **Before**: Users see a premature "Context overflow: prompt too large for the model (mid-turn precheck)." error flash during tool loops, even though the truncation+retry succeeds silently ~15 seconds later.
- **After**: Control-flow signals are silently skipped by `handleRunFailure`. No premature error events leak into the UI. Real errors still produce error events normally (regression test included).

## Evidence

### Unit & Integration Tests (114/114 passed)

Environment: Linux x86_64, Node 22.19.0, vitest 4.1.9

```
$ OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run \
    --config vitest.config.ts \
    packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts \
    src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/tool-result-context-guard.test.ts \
    src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/midturn-precheck.test.ts

 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  114 passed (114)
```

Including 2 new Agent-class tests in `agent-loop.test.ts`:

```
 ✓ suppresses failure events for control-flow errors carrying the sentinel  1ms
 ✓ still forwards real errors through handleRunFailure  1ms
```

These exercise the **real `Agent` class** (not mocked):
- Control-flow error with `Symbol.for("agent-core.controlFlowError")` → `agent.state.errorMessage` is `undefined` (no leak)
- Real `Error("provider exploded")` → `agent.state.errorMessage` is `"provider exploded"` (normal behavior preserved)

### Gateway Startup Proof

Gateway built and started successfully from the patched source tree (dirty watched source detected + rebuilt):

```
$ OPENCLAW_SKIP_CHANNELS=1 node scripts/run-node.mjs --dev gateway

[openclaw] Building TypeScript (dist is stale: dirty_watched_tree - dirty watched source tree).
[openclaw] Building bundled plugin assets.
runtime-postbuild: ...
[gateway] loading configuration…
[gateway] starting...
[gateway] agent model: openai/gpt-5.5 (thinking=medium, fast=off)
[gateway] http server listening (9 plugins: acpx, browser, canvas, device-pair,
           file-transfer, memory-core, ollama, phone-control, talk-voice; 9.6s)
[gateway] log file: /tmp/openclaw/openclaw-2026-07-07.log
[gateway] ready
```

Gateway config reload detected the midTurnPrecheck + MCP changes:

```
[gateway/reload] config change detected; evaluating reload
  (agents.defaults.compaction.midTurnPrecheck, mcp)
```

### Real Agent Instance Verification

```
=== Gateway+MCP Equivalent Verification: MidTurnPrecheckSignal ===

[Test 1] Large tool output triggers MidTurnPrecheckSignal — no UI error leak
  ✅ agent.continue() completed normally (did not throw)
  ✅ agent.state.errorMessage = undefined
  ✅ User does NOT see "Context overflow" error

[Test 2] controlFlowError sentinel marking
  ✅ sentinel direct access: true
  ✅ Symbol.for discoverable: true

[Test 3] Real errors still recorded normally
  ✅ agent.continue() completed normally
  ✅ agent.state.errorMessage = "provider connection refused"
  ✅ Real errors still visible (no regression)

=== Conclusion ===
✅ MidTurnPrecheckSignal — no UI error leak
✅ controlFlowError sentinel — correctly marked via Symbol.for
✅ Real errors — handleRunFailure behavior preserved
✅ Environment: Node v22.19.0, real Agent instances, MCP SDK available
```

### Verification Summary

| Scenario | Expected | Actual |
|----------|---------|--------|
| Control-flow error (sentinel marked) | No error event, errorMessage=undefined | ✅ |
| Real error (no sentinel) | Error event emitted, errorMessage set | ✅ |
| Gateway startup with patch | Build + start successfully | ✅ |
| Config reload (midTurnPrecheck+MCP) | Detected and evaluated | ✅ |

## Risk checklist

merge-risk: Low

- Only errors carrying `Symbol.for("agent-core.controlFlowError")` are suppressed (currently only `MidTurnPrecheckSignal`)
- Real errors (without sentinel) still trigger normal `handleRunFailure` — regression test included
- Symbol uses a generic `agent-core.controlFlowError` name owned by agent-core, not OpenClaw-specific
- Check scoped to `Agent.handleRunFailure` only (production path); not applied to `agent-loop.ts` EventStream API
- No breaking API changes, no new dependencies
